product_metadata.title: Sunbeam Royal Luxe Dove Grey Heated Personal Throw / Blanket, Cozy-Warm, Adjustable Heat Settings
features: Easy to use electric throw with push button controller, with 4 heat settings and 4-hour auto-shut off function for peace of mind
Rich and cozy royal luxe material for added warmth and comfort, stylish grey color
50" x 60", ideal size to snuggle up in
Makes a great accessory while relaxing on couch, bed or your favorite chair
Machine washable and dryer safe for easy care, 100% Polyester
description: Snuggle up with the Sunbeam Royal Luxe Heated Throw to beat those winter chills. Indulge yourself with its rich and cozy material to keep you toasty all night long or warm as you unwind. Easy to use detachable controller with 4 heat settings and a 4-hour auto-shut off feature for peace of mind. Remove the controller and place the blanket into the washer and dryer for easy cleaning.
